conversation_parts.body: Hi Bryn, it’s Brelis from Selsby Motor — we’re running claims reports late into the evening and the bright interface is straining our eyes. Any chance we can get dark mode enabled?

We’re running claims reports late into the evening and the bright interface is straining our eyes — any chance we can get dark mode enabled? It’s not urgent but would really help with our overnight reserves and payments workflow.
Internal note: Customer A19 has requested dark mode interface; no current roadmap item but logged for UX review.
Hi Brelis, thanks for reaching out. I’ve noted your request for dark mode — we don’t have it live yet, but I’ll log it with our product team for consideration in the next UI update cycle.
Appreciate you logging that. We handle a lot of late-night reserves and payments, so eye comfort matters. Let me know if there’s a timeline or workaround.

Understood — I’ll flag this as high priority for the UX squad. In the meantime, you can adjust your monitor’s night mode or reduce screen brightness as a temporary fix while we evaluate the feature request.
That’s helpful, thanks. We’ll tweak the monitor settings for now and wait for updates on dark mode.
You’re welcome, Brelis. I’ll personally follow up once we have a decision from the product team. In the meantime, if you need help with tasks or integrations, just ping us.
